column1: To calculate the growth from this data, we can look at it from two primary perspectives:
1. **Month-over-Month (MoM) Growth** in Actual Spend for the entire city (all wards combined).
2. **Start-to-End Growth** (comparing January 2024 to December 2024) across the wards and categories.

*Note: Missing actual spend values due to missing data/notes (e.g., Ward 2 in March, Ward 4 in July, Ward 1 in November) have been excluded from specific month-on-month calculations to prevent distortion.*
### 1. Overall City-Wide Actual Spend & MoM Growth
*(Summing up all valid actual spends across all 5 wards for each month)*
**Overall Trend:** Spending starts moderately in early 2024, spikes dramatically during the monsoon season (June–September, peaking in July/August), and drops back down toward December.
